source_semantics.review: Individually review all four complete files and eleven hunks of the mixed-node warning change. CdkTree reads the current node type, sets it only when unset, and warns in development on conflicting later types while retaining the initial classification. The base node adds protected readonly _type=flat and its initializer passes this._type instead of a literal flat; nested nodes override _type=nested and remove their own ngOnInit wrapper and implements OnInit. This makes classification follow the actual subtype once through the inherited initializer, while preserving parent aria level, expansion subscription/markForCheck and node registration. The complete runtime projection preserves every other operation; exact removed/added methods, import/heritage changes and protected API references remain pinned. The harness fixture changes its nested leaf markup to mat-nested-tree-node; all seven complete callbacks are unchanged. No new warning/lifecycle regression case is added by this upstream patch, so source review does not assert such execution. The owned legacy add-on has no public tree dependency, tree markup or tree fork; this warning/lifecycle/protected-contract change belongs to the unrelated peer. Do not copy the TreeControl/private machinery or make a consumer template/style change. No Angular/native/a11y/floor equivalence is claimed.
